category_name: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness during sleep
title: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness during sleep - Hisn al-Muslim 113
arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِن غَضَـبِهِ وَعِـقابِهِ وَشَـرِّ عِبـادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَـزاتِ الشَّـياطينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضـرون
transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa 'iqābihi wa sharri 'ibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn.
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the taunts of devils and from their presence.
reference: Abu Dawud 4/12. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/171
